items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1959-09-25
items.q: Well he had him, and he had Felipe Trombo from here... Well he had him, and me, and himself... I played with a whole lot in Chicago with Snaggs.

ctx.x: Who was in the band with Freddie?

He had some boys there, a light boy on tenor. And I'll tell you who he had with him. Lester Boone. You remember him? Yeah. Alco player, tenor player, something. Well he had him, and he had Felipe Trombo from here, Dutre, what's his name, Noda Dutre or something like that? Noda Dutre. Well he had him, and me, and himself, and he had a violin player named Clowns Lee. He was a good violin player, boy. He was a sweetheart. He played the devil out of the violin. And them the ones I can remember. I don't know if he had…
Well along the subject of drummers in Chicago, ever remember Andrew Hillier?

items.title: Ernest "Punch" Miller Interview, 1957-multiple
items.q: I remember a couple of them, Snag and myself and Tiny and a fellow on trombone named Eddie Ellis... Yeah, or Boone. Oh, Lester Boone.

ctx.x: Charlie Cook, Greenland. Yeah. Now, who all was in the band? Can you remember a few of the people?

Well, I remember a couple of them, Snag and myself and Tiny and a fellow on trombone named Eddie Ellis. Eddie Ellis and they had the spore on alto. I believe you used to tell me about him, about his name today on the saxophone. Yeah, or Boone. Oh, Lester Boone.
